version.changelog:
- Initial release of figma-code-optimizer skill.
- Enables code generation from Figma designs using your component library and design tokens.
- Supports mapping Figma components and styles to project code components and tokens.
- Guides on Figma file best practices for optimal code output.
- Ensures generated code is clean, maintainable, and avoids hardcoded values or unnecessary wrappers.

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only Figma→code generation skill whose requirements and runtime instructions are coherent with its stated purpose and do not request unexpected credentials or installs.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (generate production-ready front-end code from Figma respecting a design system) matches the SKILL.md content and the included reference docs. The skill does not ask for unrelated cloud credentials or system access. Note: the SKILL.md assumes the agent has access to a Figma MCP connector and to the project's component library documentation, but the skill does not declare how those connectors/credentials are provided — this is a plausible omission rather than a contradiction.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to fetching the selected frame via an MCP connector, extracting styles/tokens, mapping to component props, and generating code. The instructions do not direct the agent to read arbitrary local files, system secrets, or exfiltrate data to third-party endpoints. Minor caveat: they rely on external MCP access and on the user's component-documents for mapping; the mechanism for obtaining those (user upload, existing connector, etc.) is left unspecified.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only. This is the lowest-risk install model: nothing is downloaded or written by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or primary credential, and the SKILL.md does not instruct the agent to read system env vars. However, the workflow depends on a connected Figma MCP server and access to the project's component library/docs. Those are external resources that typically require authorization; the skill assumes such connectors exist rather than requesting credentials directly.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Flags are normal: always=false and model-invocation allowed (standard). The skill does not request persistent system-wide privileges, nor does it instruct modifying other skills or global agent config.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent and instruction-only, but before installing you should: (1) confirm how your agent/platform provides Figma access (the SKILL.md expects a connected MCP connector) and understand what that connector will upload/access in your Figma workspace; (2) be prepared to supply or point the agent to your project's component-library docs and token mappings so generated code matches your codebase; (3) test the skill on non-sensitive or sample designs first to verify output quality and that no unintended data leaves your environment; (4) if you require the agent to operate without platform connectors, expect to supply credentials or files via the normal, secure channels of your environment — the skill does not itself request or store credentials.
